'''Chris Schaut''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[February 2001 New York City tournament]] on 10 February 2001 with [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|Hunt Down Beatdown]], according to Doug Faust's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1733">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-14-decipher-day-in-nyc-10-feb-01d1733/ decipher-day-in-nyc-10-feb-01], DeckTech (Doug "Phrim" Faust, 14 February 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-14-decipher-day-in-nyc-10-feb-01d1733/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
